verdict.rationale: The endpoints doc notes that the Anthropic Messages endpoint shares the same "rate limits" as the chat models, which implies Morph documents rate limits somewhere. That single passing reference is the only on-topic evidence; dedicated endpoints for reserved capacity are an adjacent feature, not documented limits. Missing for 10: actual rate-limit values (RPM/TPM), how limits scale across usage tiers (free vs paid vs enterprise), a dedicated rate-limits page, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
